{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {duplicate_patients}')

# Check how many times each patient appears
dup_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
dup_counts_above_1 = dup_counts[dup_counts > 1]

print(f'Number of patients with multiple records: {len(dup_counts_above_1)}')
print(f'Patient IDs with multiple records: {dup_counts_above_1.index.tolist()}')

# Confirm sample_seq is used to select the latest record
print(f'Unique sample_seq values: {df["sample_seq"].unique()}')

# Check the highest sample_seq per patient
df_max_seq = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]
print(f'After deduplication (highest sample_seq per patient), number of rows: {len(df_max_seq)}')"}
